title: Kabete Vetlab Primary School polling station 10 of 12 (Kitisuru Ward, Westlands, Nairobi)

claim.sentence: the affidavit of Arnold Ochieng Oginga deals with this polling station at paragraph 17 and in the table at pages 8 to 13. According to the table, the agent's Form 34A shows Raila Odinga 236 and William Ruto 52, and the portal form shows Raila Odinga 236 and William Ruto 133. The affidavit gives the increase for William Ruto as 81 votes.
